label: Shortest travel time over open links, and whether it stays within tolerance

outputs.name: state
outputs.description: 1 if travel time <= (1 + travel_time_tolerance) x the intact network's, else 0.

description: Dijkstra on Edge.length_km / speed over the open links. The event survives if its travel time is within its tolerance of the intact network's (every link open); no route means failure. Joint across the SystemEvent plate: every event reads the same link states in the same sample.
